name: tradingview
description: Connect TradingView to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use TradingView MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect TradingView to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with market data and analytics using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my TradingView workspace.
Find anything in TradingView that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review market data and analytics in TradingView.
